# Vendored web dependencies

The dashboard includes these browser assets locally so it works without
Internet access:

- Tailwind CSS Browser 4.3.3 — MIT
- Chart.js 4.5.1 — MIT
- chartjs-adapter-date-fns 3.0.0 — MIT
- date-fns 2.30.0 (bundled by the chart adapter) — MIT
- Lucide 1.27.0 — ISC
- Geist Sans and Geist Mono variable fonts 5.3.0 — SIL Open Font License 1.1
- Socket.IO Client 4.8.1 — MIT

Full license texts are stored in `static/vendor/licenses`. The Socket.IO Client
license notice is retained in its minified source file.
